---
title: Rimelight Starter Template
description: A production-ready Astro starter powered by Cloudflare, Better Auth, Drizzle ORM, and the Rimelight UI component library.
---

The **Rimelight Starter** is a batteries-included Astro project template that wires together the entire Rimelight stack — auth, database, internationalization, open graph image generation, docs, and a full-featured UI library — so you can start shipping without boilerplate.

## What's Included

| Feature              | Technology                                                       |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Framework            | [Astro](https://astro.build) (server output, Cloudflare adapter) |
| UI Components        | [Rimelight UI](https://rimelight.com) (Astro + Vue)              |
| Authentication       | [Better Auth](https://better-auth.com)                           |
| Database             | Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) + [Drizzle ORM](https://orm.drizzle.team) |
| Internationalization | `@rimelight/i18n` + Cloudflare KV                                |
| Open Graph Images    | Satori + Resvg (edge-rendered PNG)                               |
| Docs System          | MDX content collections + versioned routing                      |
| Deployment           | [Cloudflare Workers / Pages](https://workers.cloudflare.com)     |
| Security             | `@rimelight/security` (CSP, SRI, secure cookies)                 |
| Full-Text Search     | SQLite FTS5 (in-process, no SaaS)                                |
